name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow — gestor de tareas colaborativo. Proyecto del curso de Testing y Calidad de Software.

scripts.contract:db:setup: cd server && RUST_LOG=info DATABASE_URL='file:./taskflow_test.db' npx prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && RUST_LOG=info DATABASE_URL='file:./taskflow_test.db' npm run db:seed
scripts.contract:provider:start: cd server && PORT=3001 DATABASE_URL='file:./taskflow_test.db' JWT_SECRET='taskflow-contract-test-secret' TZ='America/Montevideo' RUST_LOG=info npm run dev
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
